exposure: Sleep quality during pregnancy (Petersburg Sleep Quality Index, Epworth Sleepiness Scale, daytime sleep status)
cohort: This study included 150 pregnant women referred to 7 healthcare centers in Qazvin, Iran.
finding: No significant relationship was found between sleep quality during pregnancy and preterm birth, despite observing that preterm birth non-significantly increased with maternal age and higher Petersburg Sleep Quality Index scores in the second and third trimesters.
